_comment: Execution wiring for the generic OpenAI-compatible adapter (adapter.js). A provider absent from this map is catalog-only (discoverable, health-checkable-as-'unconfigured', but never selected for a live call) — that is the honest default, never an assumed shape. `wired: true` here means the base_url was LIVE-VERIFIED (an unauthenticated GET /models returned a real HTTP response — 200, or 401/403 confirming the endpoint exists and enforces auth) on the date below, NOT that the shape has been exercised with a real key. Cloudflare Workers AI, Google AI Studio's native REST, and Cohere's non-compat endpoint are deliberately absent: their request/response shape is not the generic OpenAI chat/completions contract, so they need their own adapter file (mirroring providers/gemini.js next to providers/openai-compat.js) rather than being force-fit here — that is the extensibility point, not a gap to silently paper over.
verification_method: unauthenticated GET against base_url + /models; 200/401/403 = endpoint exists (401/403 additionally confirms it enforces auth); 404/000 = wrong path or unreachable, excluded

cohere.verified: GET /models -> HTTP 401 (Cohere's OpenAI-compatibility endpoint, distinct from its native v1 API)
